notes.title: Merry Christmas
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Fans[/h1]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33019449/b0768830b5eaa1c91423f1ac2bb2bea6772c5d62.png[/img]

Christmas is just around the door, so we would like to wish you all the best during this Christmas. We hope that you get lots of nice gifts and have great time, among your loved ones!

Next year will mark the anniversary for Tuomo's Games, so there's going to be lots of good things in store for both old and new fans. It's thanks to all of you, who help keep the dream of making games for livelihood alive. Thank you for your support and all the feedback that you give, as it helps the games become better in future.


Wishing you the best,
Tuomo

notes.title: Border of her Heart will have a sequel!
notes.content:
[h1]I am pleased to tell Border of her Heart fans that the game will have a sequel[/h1]

The game will take place after events of the first game, however playing the first game won't be necessary as location and the people involved are all different. Some events you'll appreciate a bit more though, if you know the context to them, such as the plague.

Wishlist it today, as we'll have a small playable demo later this month!!

notes.title: Trancevania and Version 1.12
notes.content:
Halloween is almost upon us. To celebrate this ocassion, we have launched Trancevania addon,which features a new playable character and a small new dungeon. The DLC will be -10% cheaper all the way until the end of the Halloween.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/732190/Strangers_of_Power__Trancevania/

[h1]Chandra the fourth heroine[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30218695/5bb0a941244aaabdc8433787124e30c007899f54.png[/img]

Chandra is a vampire. She has no interest in saving the town of Serina and has simply come for personal reasons that are to find her missing sister, after hearing a rumor that she was in the castle. She has unique blood magic and fights using dual wielded weapons such as swords or axes. If she gets hurt, she can use a powerful blood frenzy attacks.

[h1]Version 1.12[/h1]

[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Weapon Master couldn't be talked to from a certain angle, this has been fixed[/list]

[*]Increased SPI of Zombies to 2 (was 1)
[*]Increased SPI of Golems to 2 (was 1)
[*]Increased SPI of Spiders to 3 (was 1)
[*]Increased HP of Lamias to 20 (was 18)
[*]Increased DEF of Lamias to 5 (was 4)
[*]Increased HP of Snakes to 25 (was 22)
[*]Increased SPI of Snakes to 3 (was 1)

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30218695/3d3762f2e9fab7424ef53d4976022b0e92a5200c.png[/img]
[b]Balance[/b]

[list][*]Lowered initial WIS of Gracie to 2 (was 3)
[*]Lowered the base damage of Fire Barrage to 4 (was 5)
[*]Lowered the base damage of Bolt to 4 (was 5)
[*]Lowered the base damage of Chill to 4 (was 5)
[*]Lowered the base damage of Blizzard to 8 (was 10)
[*]Lowered the base damage of Immolate to 8 (was 10)
[*]Lowered the base damage of Thunder Storm to 8 (was 10)
[*]Increased SPI of Bats to 2 (was 1)
[*]Increased HP of Zombies to 15 (was 14)
[*]Increased SPI of Zombies to 2 (was 1)
[*]Increased SPI of Golems to 2 (was 1)
[*]Increased SPI of Spiders to 3 (was 1)
[*]Increased HP of Lamias to 20 (was 18)
[*]Increased DEF of Lamias to 5 (was 4)
[*]Increased HP of Snakes to 25 (was 22)
[*]Increased SPI of Snakes to 3 (was 1)
[*]Increased DEF of Minotaur to 15 (was 13)
[*]Increased SPI of UniBunnys to 4 (was 1)
[*]Increased HP of Unibunnys to 40 (was 36)
[*]Increased SPI of Mimics to 3 (was 1)
[*]Increased SPI of Killer Plants to 4 (was 1)
[*]Increased HP of Morgan to 250 (was 200)
[*]Increased ATK of Morgan to 25 (was 24)
[*]Increased DEF of Morgan to 15 (was 14)
[*]Increased SPI of Lost Warriors to 8 (was 1)
[*]Increased HP of Madam Blueberry to 600 (was 500)
[*]Blindness now decreases Accuracy by 85% (was 50%)
[*]Blindness now decreases Evasion by 30% (was 0)
[*]Using Protect now increases defense of the user by 200% for the duration of protection
[*]Spell enchantment now gives smaller buff to WIS
[*]Removed Maiya's flare skill[/list]

[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]You could walk on lava in Cat Queen cave, this has been fixed
[*]Maiya's ending had her called wrong name, this has been fixed[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list][*]Made changes to Steal formula.
[*]Stealing from enemy who has armor or weapon, decreases their DEF, ATK, etc. for the value of the item stolen.
[*]Succesfully stealing grants a temporary buff based on item stolen for 5 turns
[*]Changed critical formulas to better account for luck
[*]NEW GAME ONLY - Maiya now has a new move "Sneak Attack" which deals damage based on her AGI and how many times she has succesfully stolen from foes
[*]Magic shopkeeper now only comments on player's magical skills first time[/list]

[b]Graphical[/b]

[list][*]Magic shopkeeper now has bust portrait [/list]

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30218695/f2a4958588404ab13762297dc515931ad9242374.png[/img]

[b]Balance[/b]

[list][*]Increased cost of Health Juice to 75 dyners (was 50)
[*]Lowered cost of Energy Juice to 100 (was 250)
[*]Lowered cost of Wonder Juice to 200 (was 250)
[*]Lowered cost of Miracle Salve to 200 (was 250)[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list][*]Energizers only restored 20 mana instead of intended 30, this has been fixed
[*]One of Gracie's attack voices was from the wrong actress, this has been fixed
[*]During certain conditions, the scene where you met Queen of Cats could lead to Kaede getting stuck, this has been fixed
[*]Teleporting from second level could cause wrong color theme to occur in the level, this has been fixed
[*]Teleporting from third level could cause wrong color theme to occur in the level, this has been fixed
[*]Teleporting from fifth level could cause wrong color theme to occur in the level, this has been fixed[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list][*]Added movement tutorial to Maiya's room
[*]Added tutorial about save crystals on first level
[*]Improved Item and Equipment screens and their information[/list]

[b]Graphical[/b]

[list][*]Added fadeout to some of the campfire cutscenes for better transition
[*]Improved graphics for the armor shop keeper
[*]Improved graphics for the inn keeper
[*]Added clutter to several buildings[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
 
[list][*]Several performance improvments[/list]
